name: vid.basic/repetition/countix
license: No license stated; Kinetics YouTube clips, video rights not established
criteria_source: Written; levels are fixed ranges of the annotated count
notes: 250 clips cut to Countix's annotated repetition interval. Same ten levels as the RepCount-A task. Known limit: counting fast cycles needs dense frames; at 1 fps the reference models score below the majority level, while OneJev-27B reached 36-40 % at 4-8 fps.

name: vid.basic/repetition/repcount_a
source: RepCount-A, test and validation splits (Hu et al., 2022)
license: No license stated; YouTube videos, rights not established
criteria_source: Written; levels are fixed ranges of the annotated count
notes: 250 clips. Ten ordered levels: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16-25, 26-50, 51 or more complete repetitions; gold is the level of the source count. Known limit: counting fast cycles needs dense frames.

name: vid.basic/state_change/changeit
criteria_source: Written from ChangeIt's annotated initial and end states of each object category
notes: 81 web videos, one each; asks whether the main demonstrated change goes from the initial to the end state, with the direction swapped in about half of the items (43 yes, 38 no). Leaf score: the mean of its sources, so these 81 items weigh as much as Ego4D-OSCC's 419.

name: vid.basic/state_change/ego4d_oscc
source: Ego4D object state change classification (OSCC), validation split (Grauman et al., 2022)
criteria_source: Adapted from the OSCC task: does an object undergo a state change in the clip
notes: 419 clips, one each; gold is the OSCC state-change label (201 yes, 218 no). The labels ship as a recipe; `jevarena-mm build` fills them in from your copy of the Ego4D annotations (Ego4D license; fetched with the videos). Leaf score: the mean of its sources, so these 419 items weigh as much as ChangeIt's 81.

name: vid.basic/temporal/ssv2
source: Something-Something v2, validation split (Goyal et al., 2017)
criteria_source: Written; gold is the direction in the SSv2 template label ('Pushing [something] from left to right')
notes: 250 pushing videos, each asked twice: a two-option direction choice and a yes/no question about one direction (125 yes, 125 no). The scenes, questions, options and answers depend on the video's label, so they ship as a recipe; `jevarena-mm build` fills them in from the validation labels of your Something-Something v2 download (fetched with the videos).

name: vid.basic/action_candidates/kinetics700
license: CC BY 4.0 (annotations); YouTube videos keep their own terms
criteria_source: Adapted: the gold class and three other Kinetics-700 class names are the options
notes: 500 ten-second clips of everyday human actions; 4 candidate actions per question.

name: vid.basic/action_category/ucf101
license: No license stated (cite Soomro et al., 2012); YouTube videos
criteria_source: Adapted: UCF101's 101 category names are the options
notes: 500 test videos; every question lists all 101 UCF101 categories (sports, body motion, playing instruments and interactions), so the model classifies over the dataset's complete label set.
